The '''Pas'sic''' were the perpetrators of the "[[Vrassh]] Slaughter". However, as of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], neither the Pas'sic government nor the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had compensated the survivors, despite the requirements of Pas'sic law.
